import hashlib
import json
import platform
import sys
from pathlib import Path

actor = Path('products/actors/csv-preflight')
sys.path.insert(0, str(actor.resolve()))
from src.core import check_text

fixtures = {
    'clean': ('station_id,reading\nDEMO-1,12\nDEMO-2,17\n', ['station_id', 'reading'], True),
    'missing_required_column': ('station_id,value\nDEMO-1,12\n', ['station_id', 'reading'], False),
    'extra_field': ('station_id,reading\nDEMO-1,12,unexpected\n', ['station_id', 'reading'], False),
}
results = {}
for name, (text, columns, expected_ok) in fixtures.items():
    result = check_text(text, required_columns=columns)
    repeated = check_text(text, required_columns=columns)
    results[name] = {'input': text, 'required_columns': columns, 'expected_ok': expected_ok, 'actual': result, 'repeat_matches': result == repeated, 'passed': result['ok'] is expected_ok and bool(result['issues']) is (not expected_ok) and result == repeated}
paths = [actor / 'src/core.py', actor / 'src/public_http.py']
report = {'scope': 'Fictional station data. Offline structural CSV validation.', 'python': platform.python_version(), 'source_sha256': {str(path): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in paths}, 'cases': results, 'all_pass': all(case['passed'] for case in results.values())}
out = Path('products/services/nlnet-csv-milestone/station-csv-acceptance.json')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'all_pass': report['all_pass'], 'cases': {name: {'passed': case['passed'], 'issues': case['actual']['issues']} for name, case in results.items()}, 'artifact': str(out)}, indent=2))
